decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain and serves a lasting B2B need, so the option stays open even though it has not been seen on the website since 2018.
The ERP interface fits the firm's multichannel direction and has strategic integration value at low upkeep cost, which still justifies holding it.
With E already gone, C can serve as the consolidated price comparison tracking plugin, keeping that option open at little cost.
D duplicates C, has been absent from the website for years and gives no sign that its value will be realized, so its resources should go to new development.
The net price reporting plugin complements A and the analytics offer at low carrying cost, but its weak visibility makes withdrawal a real possibility.
